_note: Paid generative-video tier -> fal model oracle for the video plugin. The script carries NO model IDs/body shapes/url paths — it reads them here. VERIFY endpoint ids + prices + body/url shapes via fal docs before first real use (a wrong price under-estimates a paid call). Each tier: model (fal endpoint, no leading slash); input_kind (image|text_or_image); requires_image_url; max_duration_seconds; default_duration; price_usd_per_second; prompt_field/duration_field/image_field (request body keys); output_url_path (jq dotted path to the clip url); audio.
